# Fundamentals
## To eat healthy food.
I need a good amount of protein, vegetables, fiber, and water in my body to not feel weak or tired.

## To sleep 7-8 hours every night.
I operate terribly on low sleep.

## To exercise regularly.
I need to run or lift heavy things at least 2-3 times a week to not feel like exploding.

## To create or work on creation.
I need to be creating, modifying, or testing something on a daily basis. 

A project, a metaproject, or microproject. It doesn’t necessarily matter what it is, but it has to be *something* every day. 

## To learn formal reasoning.
I need to be learning about fundamental theories, ideas, and methods of approaching problems in different disciplines.

We spend too much time in school learning theories. But the opposite, spending *zero* time learning theory and robust methods of practice, is undesirable. There has to be a balance.
